formal_statement.plain_language: The corrected implicit-midpoint Butcher arrays are the displayed sums of their full- and low-precision parts and satisfy the exact second-order consistency and smooth and nonsmooth perturbation conditions used after equation (4.1).

informal_proof: Expand the two-stage arrays, matrix-vector products, dot products, and absolute-value dot products. The printed coefficients then give the two consistency values and make every selected perturbation expression zero.
informal_statement: The exact corrected-midpoint coefficient arrays satisfy the paper's order-two consistency conditions and the smooth and nonsmooth perturbation cancellations responsible for eliminating the lower-order perturbation term.
